title: LazyVM config template
description: A named starting point for a new VM: New-LazyVM -ConfigTemplate <Name> or Build-LazyVM -ConfigTemplate <Name> applies its Settings over the shared template (the defaults and LazyVM.Settings.json). The built-in templates are in the module's Data\Templates folder, your own in <Root>\Shared\Templates.

$schema.description: Points your editor at this schema, for autocomplete and checking. Leave it as it is.

Name.description: The template's name, which -ConfigTemplate takes and Tab lists: 1-64 letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit. It names the template, not the file, and is never a setting of the VMs built from it.

Settings.description: The settings the template changes, like LazyVM.Settings.json: list only what differs from the defaults.
